name: Michael Nault
headline: IT and GRC, built hands-on.
subline: Six years in Amazon operations taught me that a control only works when people follow it and you can prove it. Now I build the systems and the evidence, for employers and for small businesses.
lookingFor: Entry-level roles in GRC and compliance, IT audit, Microsoft 365 administration or identity and access, in Orlando or remote. I'd especially value a team that mentors.

automated checks in Workspace, a SharePoint-style platform
